scope.contract: Original immutable I-005 and s3 ripple-trim row. This slice opens only RippleTrimClip shortening (in or out) of one clip plus link closure, then closes the vacated tail on participating tracks. Lengthening is refused as RIPPLE_TRIM_LENGTHEN_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Closing a move source hole is not implemented. Leave-gap TrimClip, video-only TrimClip(ripple:true), RippleDeleteClips, and reject/overwrite/insert stay distinct. DeleteClip/TrimClip ripple:true still raise LINKED_RIPPLE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED on persistent-audio/linked AV. New-track creation, cross-project bake and the OS clipboard are not implemented. I-006 roll/slip/slide and the full trim planner remain unopened.
scope.temporalSemantics: Shorten the closure by timeline δ (out: delta<0; in: delta>0 and timeline start stays, source advances). One vacated tail R=[oldEnd-δ, oldEnd) of the selected clip is then closed on all participating tracks (default: targets union syncLock media; an explicit rippleTrackIds list cannot drop targets or include a caption track). Split the later bound first, then a. Unselected items that span R keep remapped remnants; later items shift by -δ. Sequence duration shrinks by δ, but not below later ends on unmoved non-ripple tracks. Assets are kept. Remnants are not auto-joined.
scope.preserved: Link closure is complete (includeLinks=true). Source time, cropped opacity curves, static effects, proxy/asset version refs and audio offsets are preserved. Locks on a written field raise FIELD_LOCKED. A locked syncLock non-target that would have to crop or shift raises SYNC_LOCKED. Whole-group atomic refusal, never a silent subset. Transitions with a cut strictly inside R or whose endpoints vanish or lose adjacency are dropped; cuts at or after oldEnd remap and subtract δ. Absolute captions that would have to crop or shift (cue end > R.start) refuse CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; caption cue-follow/anchor policy is not opened. Over-shorten raises CLIP_TOO_SHORT.
scope.history: Each ripple trim is one existing persistent command with snapshot undo/redo, save/reopen, archive fork and AAC MP4 export. No new persistence schema or fingerprint side branch.
scope.ui: Workbench adds Ripple trim out (key ripple-trim) and Ripple trim in (key ripple-trim-in) using the existing positive-frames field. Existing Key(trim) is unchanged and still leave-gap when persistent audio is present. UI tests jump foundation-scroll and do not drag through the pointer timeline.
